items.description: Invalid lifecycle handoffs can pass validation.
items.analysis: Installed-name membership does not establish that a next skill accepts the record's lifecycle selector, and unsupported kinds are accepted.
items.recommendation: Validate kinds and recorded next workflows against declared lifecycle selectors; require next for non-terminal records.

items.description: Symlinked or unbounded JSON inputs can exhaust memory.
items.analysis: The concern assumes hostile files in a local, user-selected target.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: disproportionate hardening for the local target model.

items.description: Committed records can lack delivery evidence.
items.analysis: Delivery evidence is required only for models where committed branch-and-pull-request delivery applies.
items.recommendation: Require applicable committed-delivery evidence while preserving non-applicable delivery models.

items.description: Unreadable or invalid-UTF-8 JSON can produce a traceback.
items.analysis: Malformed JSON is handled, but decoding and I/O failures are not converted to diagnostics.
items.recommendation: Catch decoding and I/O failures at JSON-reading boundaries.

items.description: A structurally invalid or stale index.json can pass validation.
items.analysis: Object-shaped JSON alone does not establish that the generated inventory matches installed managed skills.
items.recommendation: Validate index structure and managed entries against discovered installed skills.

items.description: Terminal-transition validation depends on skill iteration order.
items.analysis: Terminal declarations are collected while transition targets are validated.
items.recommendation: Collect terminal statuses before validating transitions.

items.description: Missing queued_specs is treated as an empty queue.
items.analysis: The current queue representation is due to be removed or reworked by restructure-spec-state.
items.recommendation: Defer until restructure-spec-state replaces the current state shape.
items.dispatch_result: Deferred to state restructuring; the queue representation is expected to change.

items.description: Duplicate or conflicting queued specs can pass validation.
items.analysis: This checker will be refactored with the queue representation during state restructuring.

items.description: Malformed managed skills can be skipped as unrelated.
items.analysis: A lightweight Specle-marker classification must precede StrictYAML parsing so marked malformed skills are reported rather than ignored.
items.recommendation: Reuse the line-based marker preflight, then parse marked skills strictly.

items.description: Lifecycle-owning skills can omit an effective lifecycle declaration.
items.analysis: Presence of lifecycle is the ownership contract; its absence explicitly means no lifecycle ownership.
items.recommendation: Do not introduce a separate owner marker or registry.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: lifecycle presence is the complete ownership contract.

items.description: Compact lifecycle states accept unsupported status strings.
items.analysis: Semantic validation is inconsistently split between compact and nested lifecycle forms.
items.recommendation: Normalise both forms first, then validate all lifecycle states through the shared semantic validator.

items.description: Validation can observe a mixed target state during concurrent updates.
items.analysis: Concurrency hardening is disproportionate for the local target model, but repeated reads are unnecessary.
items.recommendation: Decline concurrency handling; revise to reuse one buffered skill file and one parsed runtime/index value per validation run.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: local-target concurrency hardening is out of scope. Read-once optimisation is captured separately in the active revision.

items.description: Runtime path values can contain terminal control characters in diagnostics.
items.analysis: The concern assumes hostile repository state or log-display manipulation.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: disproportionate hardening for the local target model.

items.description: The preserves-unknown-fields test does not prove the validator is read-only.
items.analysis: Read-only intent is already exercised by the implementation boundaries.
items.recommendation: Do not add contrived mutation-detection coverage.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: unnecessary test for an explicit read-only implementation contract.

items.description: Spec record paths can resolve outside the selected project.
items.analysis: Specle validates user-authored project state and does not vet whether a user-intended path is inside the selected root.
items.recommendation: Reject path-containment checks for the current contract.
items.dispatch_result: Declined: outside the validator's user-intent model.
